##load library

```{r}
# --- Load Libraries ---

library(flowCore)
library(uwot)
library(tidyverse)
library(viridis)
library(ggh4x)
library(dbplyr)
# --- Custom Theme ---
# A custom ggplot theme is defined for consistent plot styling.
ct2 <- theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(color = "black"),
        # axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black"),
        # text = element_text(family = "Arial"),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), 
        axis.ticks.x.bottom = element_blank())
```

# Read the exported CD4+ file

```{r}

fcs_file <- read.FCS("./data/AIMmerged_CD4.fcs", 
                     transformation = FALSE, 
                     truncate_max_range = FALSE)
markernames(fcs_file)
```
# UMAP from flowjo
```{r}
umap_coords <- exprs(fcs_file)[, c(47, 48)]
plot_df <- as.data.frame(umap_coords)

# 2. Rename for easier plotting
colnames(plot_df) <- c("UMAP1", "UMAP2")

# 3. Create a density plot (best for 200k cells)
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = UMAP2, y = UMAP1)) +
  stat_density_2d(aes(fill = after_stat(level)), geom = "polygon") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Existing FlowJo CD4+ UMAP",
       x = "UMAP-X", y = "UMAP-Y")



```
#---viualizing each AIM marker on the umap-----------------------------------------
```{r}

# 1. Map markers to FJComp channels
marker_map <- pData(parameters(fcs_file))[, c("name", "desc")]
my_markers <- c("TNFa", "OX40", "CD25", "CD137", "CD40L", "IL-2", "CD200", "CD69")

# Lookup the correct detector names
target_channels <- marker_map$name[match(my_markers, marker_map$desc)]
names(target_channels) <- my_markers 

# 2. Extract UMAP coords and Marker data from the full fcs_file
# Using the specific CD4+ UMAP columns (47 and 48) identified earlier
plot_data <- as.data.frame(exprs(fcs_file)[, c("UMAP.1.CD4+.KTVZ", "UMAP.2.CD4+.KTVZ", target_channels)])
colnames(plot_data) <- c("UMAP1", "UMAP2", names(target_channels))

# 3. Reshape and Transform
plot_long <- plot_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(names(target_channels)), 
               names_to = "Marker", 
               values_to = "Intensity") %>%
  mutate(Intensity = asinh(Intensity / 150))
# 0. Capture the original ranges from the full dataset
xlim_range <- range(plot_long$UMAP2)
ylim_range <- range(plot_long$UMAP1)
# 4. Normalize each marker's intensity to 0-1 range
plot_long_norm <- plot_long %>%
  group_by(Marker) %>%
  mutate(Intensity = (Intensity - min(Intensity)) / (max(Intensity) - min(Intensity))) %>%
  ungroup()
# Define your specific thresholds for each marker
custom_thresholds <- data.frame(
  Marker = c("TNFa", "OX40", "CD25", "CD137", "CD40L", "IL-2", "CD200", "CD69"),
  threshold = c(0.65,  0.70,   0.75,   0.80,    0.75,    0.80,   0.70,    0.80)
)

# Apply the specific thresholds
plot_long_high <- plot_long_norm %>%
  inner_join(custom_thresholds, by = "Marker") %>%
  dplyr::filter(Intensity > threshold) %>%
  ungroup()
# 5. Plot using the normalized data
plot <- ggplot(plot_long_norm, aes(x = UMAP2, y = UMAP1, z = Intensity)) +
  stat_summary_2d(fun = mean, bins = 500, color = NA) + 
  # This line forces the plot to stay the same size regardless of the filter
  coord_fixed(xlim = xlim_range, ylim = ylim_range) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c("black", "blue", "red"), 
                       name = "Relative\nExpression") +
  facet_wrap(~Marker, ncol = 4) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), # Remove major grid
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), # Remove minor grid
    axis.text = element_blank(),        # Optional: Remove UMAP coordinates
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),       # Optional: Remove ticks
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA), # Black background makes colors pop
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)    # Keep outer area white
  ) +
  labs(title = "Normalized Marker Expression (Min-Max scaled per panel)")
ggsave("./figs/CD4_UMAP_Panels.pdf", plot = plot, width = 20, height = 8, units = "in", limitsize = FALSE)
# 6. Plot using the normalized data, high intensity cells
plotHighAIM <- ggplot(plot_long_high, aes(x = UMAP2, y = UMAP1, z = Intensity)) +
  stat_summary_2d(fun = mean, bins = 500, color = NA) + 
  # This line forces the plot to stay the same size regardless of the filter
  coord_fixed(xlim = xlim_range, ylim = ylim_range) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c("black", "blue", "red"), limits = c(0, 1),
                       name = "Relative\nExpression") +
  facet_wrap(~Marker, ncol = 4) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), # Remove major grid
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), # Remove minor grid
    axis.text = element_blank(),        # Optional: Remove UMAP coordinates
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),       # Optional: Remove ticks
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA), # Black background makes colors pop
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)    # Keep outer area white
  ) +
  labs(title = "top Normalized Marker Expression (Min-Max scaled per panel)")
ggsave("./figs/CD4_UMAP_Panels_AIMhigh.pdf", plot = plotHighAIM, width = 20, height = 8, units = "in", limitsize = FALSE)
#-----------overlapping the top cells---------------------------

# 1. Identify cells that passed the threshold and count how many markers they express
polyfunctional_data <- plot_long_high %>%
  group_by(UMAP1, UMAP2) %>% 
  summarise(OverlapCount = n(), .groups = "drop")
polyfunctional_data <- polyfunctional_data %>% dplyr::filter(OverlapCount > 2) 


plotoverlay <- ggplot(polyfunctional_data, aes(x = UMAP2, y = UMAP1, z = OverlapCount)) +
  # Use stat_summary_2d to show the 'hottest' count in each area
  stat_summary_2d(fun = max, bins = 500, color = NA) + 
  # This line forces the plot to stay the same size regardless of the filter
  coord_fixed(xlim = xlim_range, ylim = ylim_range) +
  # Custom scale: 0 (Black) to 8 (Yellow)
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c("black", "red"), 
                       breaks = 1:8,
                       limits = c(1, 8),
                       name = "Number of\nMarkers") +
  
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white")
  ) +
  labs(title = "Polyfunctional CD4+ T-cells",
       subtitle = "AIM marker co-expression (overlap >=3 )")
ggsave("./figs/CD4_UMAP_Panels_AIMhighoverlay(n>=3).pdf", plot = plotoverlay, width = 20, height = 8, units = "in", limitsize = FALSE)

plot_long_combined <- plot_long_high %>%
  left_join(polyfunctional_data, by = c("UMAP1", "UMAP2"))
plot_long_combined<-plot_long_combined%>%dplyr::filter(OverlapCount > 2) 
plotoverlaypanels <- ggplot(plot_long_combined, aes(x = UMAP2, y = UMAP1, z = Intensity)) +
  stat_summary_2d(fun = mean, bins = 500, color = NA) + 
  # This line forces the plot to stay the same size regardless of the filter
  coord_fixed(xlim = xlim_range, ylim = ylim_range) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c("black", "blue", "red"), limits = c(0, 1),
                       name = "Relative\nExpression") +
  facet_wrap(~Marker, ncol = 4) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), # Remove major grid
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), # Remove minor grid
    axis.text = element_blank(),        # Optional: Remove UMAP coordinates
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),       # Optional: Remove ticks
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA), # Black background makes colors pop
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)    # Keep outer area white
  ) +
  labs(title = "AIM marker co-expression (overlap >=3 ))")
ggsave("./figs/CD4_UMAP_Panels_AIMhighoverlaypanels.pdf", plot = plotoverlaypanels, width = 20, height = 8, units = "in", limitsize = FALSE)



```

# look at the distribution of overlapcount

```{r}
# Calculate the frequency of each overlap count
dist_data_poly <- polyfunctional_data %>% 
  dplyr::filter(OverlapCount > 2) 
dist_data_poly<- dist_data_poly %>% count(OverlapCount) %>% 
  mutate(Percent = n / sum(n) * 100) # Optional: calculate percentage

# Plot the distribution
ggplot(dist_data_poly, aes(x = factor(OverlapCount), y = n, fill = OverlapCount)) +
  geom_col(color = "black") +
  # Apply your specific Black -> Blue -> Yellow theme to the bars
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c("black", "blue", "cyan", "yellow"), 
                       limits = c(1, 8)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Marker Overlaps",
       subtitle = "Frequency of polyfunctional CD4+ cells",
       x = "Number of Markers (Overlap Count)",
       y = "Number of Cells") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(Percent, 1), "%")), vjust = -0.5) + # Add % labels
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
```


# UMAP new calculation
```{r}
# 3. Downsample to 200,000 cells
set.seed(123)
target_cells <- 200000
if (nrow(fcs_file) > target_cells) {
  idx <- sample(1:nrow(fcs_file), target_cells)
  fcs_sub <- fcs_file[idx, ]
} else {
  fcs_sub <- fcs_file
}

# 4. Transform Markers
# IMPORTANT: Replace these with your actual fluorescent channel names
my_markers <- c("TNFa", "OX40", "CD25", "CD137", "CD40L", "IL-2", "CD200","CD69") 

umap_input <- exprs(fcs_sub)[, my_markers]
umap_input <- asinh(umap_input / 150) # Arcsinh transform

# 5. Optimized UMAP
# n_threads: Set to your CPU cores (usually 4 or 8)
umap_results <- uwot::umap(umap_input, 
                           n_neighbors = 15, 
                           min_dist = 0.1, 
                           fast_sgd = TRUE, # Speeds up optimization
                           n_threads = 4,   # Parallel processing
                           verbose = TRUE)

# 6. Visualize with Density
plot_df <- as.data.frame(umap_results)
colnames(plot_df) <- c("UMAP1", "UMAP2")

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2)) +
  geom_bin2d(bins = 200) + # Bins prevent "point blobs" with 200k cells
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "UMAP: 200,000 CD4+ Cells")
```
